conditions.notes: OBS-0016 offers an explanation for DIM-0001's eight-state dormancy that the proposal could not see about itself: it proposed a coordinate for 'any transformation recorded in the field' while the field's ontology, unlike its source document's, never made transformations first-class — the dimension's natural bearer did not exist, so the proposal had nowhere to land short of an L3 nobody was forced to confront. Complement, not challenge: DIM-0001's own text was scrupulously honest about its L1 standing and the L3 it awaited; what it lacked was the information that the awaited enactment had a missing ontological precondition. The enactment path discussed at F9 (house reversibility on transformation signatures, transforms-into relations, and chronicle transitions) works within the eleven-kind ontology; whether the thirteenth kind should instead be restored is deliberately left as its own future L3 question, not bundled.
